title: THE OLYMPIAD · CHAIN LAPS
why: Yesterday was an unplanned day off, so this card rolls forward unchanged: three unbroken double-kettlebell chains per lap, then a short incline leg. Five laps for time, legs and lungs loaded together. Fresh off 8 hours of sleep with nothing sore, run it as written.

blocks.title: WARM-UP · 6 MIN · ONE PASS
blocks.meta: Moves Method Day B · ankles / knees / hips + clean groove

items.name: Shoulder extensions ×10
items.detail: hands behind on the bench, sit the hips forward

blocks.title: THE OLYMPIAD · 5 LAPS FOR TIME
blocks.meta: FOR TIME · 5 LAPS · 3 chains + 1 incline leg per lap · cap 26:00 · 2×45 lb · 50 reps per lap
blocks.format: One clock. Each lap: Chain 1, Chain 2, Chain 3, then the belt. Every chain is one unbroken set of 5: the bells do not touch the floor until the chain is done. Rest only between chains. Score = time for 5 laps. Log the time, the first chain to break, slowest chain and RPE.
blocks.workRest: LEG every lap: 0.15 mi @ 8.0 mph at 4% incline (about 1:05). Laps 4-5 at 8.5 if laps 1-3 landed under 5:00 each.

items.name: C1 · Double clean → front squat → jerk 2×45 ×5
C2 · Double clean → front-rack split squat ×5/side → thruster 2×45 ×5
items.detail: one clean, then 5 split squats each leg in the rack, then 5 thrusters

items.name: C3 · Up-down ×5 → double high pull 2×45 ×5 → bench jump-over ×5
items.detail: up-down = drop flat, feet back in, stand

blocks.noteGreen: Green (today): 5 laps, cap 26:00, stretch under 23:00. If you finish under 22:00, lap 6 = C1 + C3 + leg at 8.5.
blocks.noteYellow: Yellow: 4 laps, C1 and C2 on the 35 lb single bell (one arm each side), legs flat at 8.0.
blocks.text: Up-down is new: hands down, kick the feet back so the chest is just off the floor, hop the feet back in, stand. Bench jump-over: two feet over the bench and back counts as one.

blocks.title: MIDLINE CLOSE · 3 ROUNDS
blocks.meta: 3 ROUNDS · walkout + leg raise + windmill · straight through

items.name: Hand walkout ×8
items.detail: walk the hands out until the hips want to sag, walk back

items.name: Bench leg raise ×12
items.detail: hands hold the bench behind the head, low back stays down
